name: Gines (Spain)
description: Three horizontal stripes of blue, yellow and blue in the proportions 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Gines (a cross, a tower and a tree on white and green).
history: The flag of Gines was approved on 23 July 2004 and came into force after publication in the BOJA of 9 August; it is rectangular with three horizontal stripes of proportions 1/4, 1/2 and 1/4, the upper blue, the central yellow and the lower blue. From a heraldic perspective the ensign is considered derived from the flag of Spain, and in its symbolism the blue represents the skies of Gines and the yellow its lands and old wheat fields.
